description: CICFlowMeter-compatible feature schema for SENTINEL-AI. This is the single source of truth used by both the training pipeline and the live flow aggregator.

features.name: flow_duration
features.description: Duration of the flow in microseconds

features.name: total_fwd_packets
features.description: Total packets in the forward direction

features.name: total_bwd_packets
features.description: Total packets in the backward direction

features.name: total_length_fwd_packets
features.description: Total size of packets in the forward direction

features.name: total_length_bwd_packets
features.description: Total size of packets in the backward direction

features.name: fwd_packet_length_max
features.description: Maximum size of packet in forward direction

features.name: fwd_packet_length_min
features.description: Minimum size of packet in forward direction

features.name: fwd_packet_length_mean
features.description: Mean size of packet in forward direction

features.name: fwd_packet_length_std
features.description: Standard deviation of packet size in forward direction

features.name: bwd_packet_length_max
features.description: Maximum size of packet in backward direction

features.name: bwd_packet_length_min
features.description: Minimum size of packet in backward direction

features.name: bwd_packet_length_mean
features.description: Mean size of packet in backward direction

features.name: bwd_packet_length_std
features.description: Standard deviation of packet size in backward direction

features.name: flow_bytes_per_s
features.description: Flow bytes per second

features.name: flow_packets_per_s
features.description: Flow packets per second

features.name: flow_iat_mean
features.description: Mean inter-arrival time of flow packets

features.name: flow_iat_std
features.description: Standard deviation of inter-arrival time

features.name: flow_iat_max
features.description: Maximum inter-arrival time

features.name: flow_iat_min
features.description: Minimum inter-arrival time

features.name: fwd_iat_total
features.description: Total inter-arrival time in forward direction

features.name: fwd_iat_mean
features.description: Mean inter-arrival time in forward direction

features.name: fwd_iat_std
features.description: Standard deviation of IAT in forward direction

features.name: fwd_iat_max
features.description: Maximum IAT in forward direction

features.name: fwd_iat_min
features.description: Minimum IAT in forward direction

features.name: bwd_iat_total
features.description: Total inter-arrival time in backward direction

features.name: bwd_iat_mean
features.description: Mean inter-arrival time in backward direction

features.name: bwd_iat_std
features.description: Standard deviation of IAT in backward direction

features.name: bwd_iat_max
features.description: Maximum IAT in backward direction

features.name: bwd_iat_min
features.description: Minimum IAT in backward direction

features.name: fwd_psh_flags
features.description: Number of times PSH flag was set in forward direction

features.name: fwd_urg_flags
features.description: Number of times URG flag was set in forward direction

features.name: fwd_header_length
features.description: Total bytes used for headers in the forward direction

features.name: bwd_header_length
features.description: Total bytes used for headers in the backward direction

features.name: fwd_packets_per_s
features.description: Number of forward packets per second

features.name: bwd_packets_per_s
features.description: Number of backward packets per second

features.name: packet_length_min
features.description: Minimum length of a packet

features.name: packet_length_max
features.description: Maximum length of a packet

features.name: packet_length_mean
features.description: Mean length of a packet

features.name: packet_length_std
features.description: Standard deviation of packet length

features.name: packet_length_variance
features.description: Variance of packet length

features.name: syn_flag_count
features.description: Number of packets with SYN flag

features.name: ack_flag_count
features.description: Number of packets with ACK flag

label_schema.mapping_notes: Raw dataset labels are mapped to this 6-class schema during preprocessing. See ml/data/preprocessing.py for the exact mapping.
